verdict.line: You lose if you trade poke damage into his Thick Skin sustain and eat a stacked Tongue Lash stun behind his level-6 Abyssal Dive/Devour; you win if you deny those resets and convert your Mercury Hammer burst combo into a lead once Tear and Youmuu's come online.

brief.thesis: Tahm Kench's E (Thick Skin) passively banks a percentage of damage he takes and heals it back out of combat, so Jayce's ranged poke gets refunded unless he commits to a full trade. His Q (Tongue Lash) stacks An Acquired Taste toward a stun on the third hit, which is the setup for the W (Abyssal Dive) knockup into R (Devour) all-in that produces his solo-kill edge. That structural mismatch between Jayce's chip-damage kit and Tahm's damage-to-sustain conversion is why Jayce sits at 44.8% over 210 games despite having the longer-range tools.

theirWindow.what: His next Tongue Lash stuns and consumes the stacks, and with Abyssal Dive available he can knock you up into a Devour. Disengage before the fourth Q lands rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: He just used E to shield off a trade
yourWindow.what: Thick Skin's stored damage resets once he converts it to a shield, so immediately follow up with Cannon Q (Shock Blast) through the Acceleration Gate for free poke he can't sustain back.

start.why: 94.7% pick rate at 45.2% WR over 248 games; the sustained damage and lifesteal matter more here than Doran's Shield's block-chip since you're trying to win extended pokes, not tank his auto resets.

boots.why: 45.3% WR over 64 games, better than Lucidity Boots' 41.1%. The tenacity shortens the stun window off his stacked Tongue Lash and the magic resist blunts Abyssal Dive and Devour, both magic damage.

core.why: First item on the highest-winrate core path (50% over 18 games) and lets you spam Shock Blast poke without running dry.
The active haste and burst let you dodge the Abyssal Dive knockup and close the gap for a Mercury Hammer leap-and-knock combo.
Converts your stacked mana into the burst damage that actually outpaces his Thick Skin regen instead of just chipping it.
Completes the 50%-winrate path and adds the burst/mobility to punish him the moment his shield is down.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winrate page here (51.2% over Stormraider's 47.7%); the free sustain and max-HP scaling let you actually survive his Tongue Lash poke phase instead of losing the chip war to his Thick Skin regen.

summoners.why: Ignite's 48.9% WR beats Teleport's 44.3% here specifically because it cuts the healing from his Tongue Lash passive and Thick Skin's out-of-combat regen, turning your poke into damage that actually sticks instead of getting refunded.

playing.title: Poke through the Acceleration Gate
playing.detail: Stay in Cannon stance and fire Q (Shock Blast) through your own E (Acceleration Gate) for the extended range, speed, and damage bonus, keeping you outside his 900-range Tongue Lash threat while he's unstacked.

playing.title: Track your Acquired Taste stacks
playing.detail: The buff icon on your bar shows his stack count on you; at 3 stacks his next Tongue Lash stuns and consumes them, so disengage before that fourth hit rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Don't chip without a follow-up
playing.detail: His E (Thick Skin) banks a percent of damage taken and heals it back out of combat, so poke you don't capitalize on gets refunded. Either commit to a full trade or hold the auto.

playing.title: Punish his shield reset
playing.detail: Once he converts stored Thick Skin damage into a shield to survive a trade, his bank is empty. That's the window to immediately re-engage with free poke.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-ins
playing.detail: Once he has R (Devour) and W (Abyssal Dive) off cooldown, a knockup into a Devour can solo-kill you. Don't stand in minion-clear range when both are up.

playing.title: Transform to Hammer for picks
playing.detail: After he's dumped his stacks or W on a missed engage, use R to become Mercury Hammer, leap with Q (To the Skies!), and knock him off position with E (Thundering Blow) before he can Devour you.

playing.title: Rush Tear into Youmuu's
playing.detail: The 50%-winrate Tear-into-Youmuu's-into-Muramana path gives you the mana sustain to keep poking and the mobility to dodge his dive-stun combo once you hit that item spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning tying those numbers to Thick Skin's sustain conversion and the Tongue Lash stack-stun is my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful as Tahm Kench’s (Q) can be fatal. Use Phase Rush and focus your plays on farming and contesting lane. Use brushes to poke from afar.
